name: Color Clips
description: Set the color of session clips on the ticked tracks. Optionally color those scenes too.

fields.label: Color (#RRGGBB)
fields.hint: Enter any hex color code, e.g. #3b82f6 for blue or #ef4444 for red.

fields.label: Also color those scenes? (yes / no)
fields.hint: Type yes to also apply the color to the scene rows, or no to only color clips.
